notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Memnite.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Memnite.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Memnite, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Memnite dies, Koll triggers, returning Memnite from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.
